title: Server starts with an empty DATA_DIR and does not touch server/pos.db
given: Empty scratch DATA_DIR, WHATSAPP=off, OTP_OFF unset
then: Server is listening; /api/health 200; server/pos.db mtime unchanged; log tells how to create the first restaurant

title: tenant-cli creates two restaurants
when: create karachi-grill (owner 03001111111 / pw 'grill-pass-1') and lahore-bbq (owner 03002222222 / pw 'bbq-pass-2'); list
then: Both listed active; DATA_DIR/tenants/<id>/pos.db exists for each; each prints an owner PIN

title: Owner sign-in needs a code on a new device, not on a trusted one
when: POST /api/auth/owner/login karachi owner, device_id d1 → otp_required; read code from server log; POST /api/auth/owner/otp; then login again with d1
then: First login {otp_required:true}; OTP returns owner_token + restaurants [karachi-grill] only; second login with d1 returns owner_token directly; wrong password → 401

title: Owner cannot enter a restaurant they don't own
then: 403; enter karachi-grill → 200 with token and restaurant.slug karachi-grill

title: Session token from A is useless on B
when: With karachi admin token: GET /api/menu X-Tenant karachi-grill; then same token with X-Tenant lahore-bbq

title: Data written in A never shows in B
when: In karachi-grill (admin) create product 'Karachi Special Tikka'; create and pay an order. Then enter lahore-bbq as its owner and GET /api/menu, /api/orders, /api/summary
then: lahore-bbq has no 'Karachi Special Tikka', no karachi order, its own totals only

title: PIN login requires a device of that restaurant
when: POST /api/login {user_id, pin} with X-Tenant only; then create device in karachi (POST /api/devices) and login with X-Device; then use karachi's device key with lahore's user_id/PIN
then: No device → 403 code no_device; with karachi device + karachi owner PIN → 200 token; lahore user via karachi device → 401

title: Revoked device stops working
when: Revoke the karachi device; call GET /api/till and POST /api/login with its key

title: PIN lockout is per restaurant+device, not global
when: 5 wrong PINs on karachi device A; then a correct PIN on karachi device A; then a correct PIN on lahore device
then: karachi device A → 429 locked; lahore device login → 200 (not affected)

title: Suspended restaurant: no new orders, old data readable
then: New order → 402 with the suspended message; GET works; lahore-bbq unaffected; activate restores ordering

title: QR ordering link carries the restaurant
when: Get a karachi table QR token; open /t/karachi-grill/<token> in the browser; place an order. Try /t/lahore-bbq/<karachi token>
then: Karachi menu shows and the request reaches karachi's QR requests; the lahore-slug URL shows an error, never karachi's menu

title: Sign-in screen → code → app, one restaurant skips picker
when: Fresh browser (empty localStorage) at /; sign in as karachi owner; enter code from server log
then: Sign-in screen visible first (phone, password, 'Sign in'); code step; lands in the app as admin with 'Karachi Grill' visible; no restaurant picker shown

title: Owner with two restaurants sees the picker
when: Link the karachi owner to lahore-bbq too (tenant-cli or API); sign in fresh
then: 'Choose a restaurant' lists Karachi Grill and Lahore BBQ; choosing Lahore BBQ opens its data

title: Use this device as a till → lock screen → staff PIN
when: In app as owner: Settings → Devices → 'Use this device as a till', name 'Till 1'
then: Owner signed out; lock screen shows 'Karachi Grill' and 'Till 1' and staff name buttons; tap owner name, enter PIN → app opens; reload page → lock screen again (device remembered); buttons ≥44px tall

title: Both themes readable, no console errors
when: Visit sign-in and till lock screens in light and dark color scheme
then: No uncaught console errors; text visible (not same colour as background); no all-caps labels; no alert/confirm/prompt dialogs

title: No module-level database work or shared state
then: No db.prepare/db.exec outside functions; loginFails keyed by tenant+device; trust proxy set; lint passes (npm --prefix client run lint)

title: Data survives restart; backup works
when: Restart server with the same DATA_DIR; call tenancy.backupAll(dir) (small script)
then: Both restaurants and the karachi product still there; one valid .db file per restaurant in dir (opens and has products table)
